product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow is an AI-powered survey and customer-experience platform that helps businesses collect, analyze, and act on customer and employee feedback.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering-authored posts cover a zero-downtime PostgreSQL upgrade (Ganapathi Subramanian, March 5, 2025) and implementation of global webhooks (Naveen RK, August 6, 2024).

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains numerous integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job boards list current roles but none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; the previously advertised Machine Learning & AI Systems Engineer listing is explicitly closed. Assessment uses the available November 2026 listings.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list identifies OpenAI for survey templates and Azure OpenAI for generative AI; it does not identify a specific model version.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims include SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not independent certifications. PCI compliance is attributed to the payment processor, not SurveySparrow itself.

last_funding.notes: The announcement body is datelined April 2, 2019; its October 2026 page-header date is not the funding date. PitchBook independently lists the same April 2019 round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round is April 2019, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Development Representative - US posting is listed, dated September 30, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced Echo, its AI Customer Feedback Agent, on September 17, 2026, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Vipin Thomas ended his VP Revenue Operations & Strategy role in June 2026 and joined Freshworks that month, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting names these as examples of CRM and outbound-sales tools; this is a hiring-stack signal, not proof of an exclusive or company-wide deployment.
